title: OpenStax says early words are often nouns for familiar objects or events
summary: OpenStax says the early vocabulary is limited to familiar objects or events, and is often nouns.
body: In the one-word stage, OpenStax Psychology 7.2 says the child's early vocabulary is limited to familiar objects or events, often nouns. The textbook does not print a count of nouns or a list of which nouns come first. It points to Fernandez and Cairns, 2011, for the stage description. This is a textbook summary, not the CDC 15-month milestone and not a laboratory count of nouns. The book is the CC BY 4.0 first edition.

sources.title: Psychology, section 7.2 Language
